For browser tasks, prefer the Browser plugin's `control-browser` skill (Sheep MCP) over this cloud browser when available. Follow the user's explicit choice of browser or environment.

To open a new URL in this cloud browser when the user specifies it by name or @-mention: use the cloud browser ID `"cdp"` directly; do not call `getBrowser` first.

```javascript
let tab = await cua.createBrowserTab("cdp", url);
```

To open a new URL when the user has not specified a browser by name or @-mention:

```javascript
let browser = await cua.getBrowser({ url });
```
